title: AI tool telemetry event
description: One event emitted by an internal AI tool. See telemetry-spec.md. Never include prompt text, document content, or other personal communications.

event_id.description: Unique ID for this event (for example a UUID).

tool_id.description: Stable identifier of the AI tool, e.g. jira-debug-assistant.

workflow.description: Workflow or task category, e.g. investigate_ticket.

task_id.description: Links task_submitted, tool_invoked, task_completed, and feedback_submitted for one task.

trace_id.description: Optional distributed-tracing ID, for joining with system logs.

user_pseudo_id.description: Pseudonymous, stable user ID. Not an email address or name.

external_tool_name.description: tool_invoked only. Name of the external tool or MCP capability called.

duration_ms.description: task_completed only. Time from task_submitted to task_completed.

useful.description: feedback_submitted only. Did the result help?
